function.arguments:
{"title": "store.List panics when offset is past the end of a user's reminders", "body": "Cause: (*Store).List in store/store.go computes end := min(offset+limit, len(out)) and returns out[offset:end]. When offset > len(out), end < offset and the slice expression panics. Reachable from GET /v1/reminders?offset=N with N beyond the user's live reminder count (api.listReminders -> Store.List). api.page only rejects negative offsets, so the store must handle any valid offset.

Fix: return nil when offset >= len(out) before slicing.

Reproducer: store.TestListOffsetPastEnd (store/list_offset_test.go).

Reports (fingerprint fp_6a569c, all v1.4.0, commit 9c41e7a): cr_60d481, cr_1a9ce5, cr_76768c, cr_ed4938, cr_1e48bd, cr_8a89f7.", "fingerprint": "fp_6a569c", "reproducer": {"file": "store/list_offset_test.go", "function": "TestListOffsetPastEnd"}, "root_cause": {"file": "store/store.go", "function": "(*Store).List"}}

Reproducer store/list_offset_test.go TestListOffsetPastEnd fails before, passes after. Full suite passes. api.page validates offset<0 only, so store is correct place."}
